subject.title: feat(canvas): export widgets as PNG — copy or download from the card menu

question: Should OpenClaw ship built-in PNG export controls on every web-chat canvas widget, rather than leaving sharing to browser screenshots or a future canvas-specific product surface?
rationale: This is a new built-in Control UI capability, and the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit maintainer decision even though the proposed implementation is focused.

options.title: Sponsor the built-in export
options.body: Accept the widget-card export UX after an end-to-end proof confirms copy and download behavior in the real Control UI.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep download-only or another smaller export path if clipboard support is not desired across supported browsers.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Do not merge the new UI surface until canvas export has an explicitly approved product direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the built-in export
recommendation.body: Accept the widget-card export UX after an end-to-end proof confirms copy and download behavior in the real Control UI.

likelyOwner.reason: The submitted implementation and proof place this contributor closest to the immediate canvas-export design discussion, although current-main ownership was not independently verified.
